title: Land the editorial study scripts and the isotonic calibration work on develop
description: The editorial prequential study (scripts/run_editorial_prequential_study.py, replay_feedback_policy.py, the OpenAI decision adapter, export_editorial_evaluator_aggregates.py) and the head.py isotonic calibration and cycle_replay resume changes exist only as uncommitted work in the main checkout at ~/Projects/Cyclotron. Nothing below can be reproduced until they are committed, tested, and merged to develop and main. Acceptance: make test green with the new specs; the 400-cycle fixture in Cyclotron-web regenerates byte-identical from the committed scripts, or the diff is explained.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Landed on feat/editorial-study-scripts. Finding: almost all of the uncommitted work was already on develop (407ab02 live replay feedback policies and calibration; the scorecard-to-cyclotron rename since). The main checkout's index is a stale pre-rename snapshot, which is why seven already-committed files showed as untracked; they are byte-identical to develop. The only un-landed change was the rubric_trigger block in protocol.json of run_editorial_prequential_study.py; it is landed with a dry-run spec. make test was red in a plain checkout (embedded_store_test subprocesses could not import the package); fixed with pytest pythonpath=src and an explicit PYTHONPATH for the subprocess. Fixture check: Cyclotron-web scripts/extract-editorial-runs.py over /private/tmp/cyclotron-editorial-study-v1 (all, reject_half, casual_ten_percent) with the semantic-v2 corpus regenerates components/fixtures/editorial-run-v1.json byte-identical. That recording (3.8 GB) and the corpus (~/Documents/Codex/2026-10-08/task-2/semantic-v2) live outside any repository; /private/tmp is not durable.
